summary: Place coursework context, expanded instructions and rubric before instructor results. Keep the grade badge at the beginning and show one current grade/feedback with collapsed provenance and history.
rationale: One current displayed result is selected from existing attributed records. UI edits supersede the current external outcome or submission-linked grade through existing routes. Original records and sources are retained in hidden history, not erased. No API uniqueness constraint, grade inference, persistence migration or scoring change is introduced.
authorization: User browser comments explicitly request coursework description/instructions/rubric first, grades/feedback last, retaining the initial grade badge, hiding the full history, and showing only one current grade and feedback per coursework.
validation: Frontend build passed; authoring browser journey passed including instruction order, one current grade, no duplicate add action, hidden prior feedback, upload and correction with preserved attachment, and narrow-screen layout. Full backend suite: 156 passed with two dependency deprecation warnings. Live browser verified reordered coursework and collapsed history. Architecture structural and committed-diff coverage checks run before completion.
rollback: Revert this UI and documentation commit and rebuild web. All source versions, coursework outcomes and submission-linked grades remain stored; no learner data migration or deletion occurs.
